english.title: Racially / religiously aggravated intentional harassment - words
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to cause **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) harassment, alarm or distress, used threatening, abusive or insulting words or behaviour or disorderly behaviour thereby causing that person or another harassment, alarm or distress, which was racially or religiously aggravated in accordance with section 28 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(1)(b) and (4) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with intent to cause harassment/alarm/distress
used threatening/abusive/insulting words/behaviour/disorderly behaviour
thereby causing that person/another harassment/alarm/distress
the offence was racially/religiously aggravated

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is OBSOLETE. Now see CJS Code CD98067 and Offence Wording H10004.
(i) The option to return an alternative verdict of guilty of the basic offence is NOT available in the magistrates court, therefore the basic offence should be charged in addition to the aggravated offence.
(ii) If on a trial on Indictment of a person charged with this offence the jury find him not guilty of the offence charged, they may find him guilty of the basic offence contrary to Section 4A of the Public Order Act 1986.
(iii) For the racially or religiously wordings see offence wordings: H2803 and H4734.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Aflonyddu bwriadol a waethygir gan ffactorau hiliol/crefyddol - geiriau
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gan fwriadu achosi aflonyddwch, braw neu drallod i **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), bu i chi ddefnyddio geiriau neu ymddygiad bygythiol, difrol neu sarhaus neu ymddygiad afreolus a thrwy hynny achosi aflonyddwch, braw neu drallod i'r unigolyn hwnnw neu i unigolyn arall a hynny wedi'i waethygu gan ffactorau hiliol neu grefyddol yn unol ag adran 28 Deddf Trosedd ac Anhrefn 1998
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 31(1)(b) a (4) Deddf Trosedd ac Anhrefn 1998.
